text:
mira: quick heads up — nightly link-scan flagged ~12 404s under /runtime/guide and a couple in /kb. most look like S3 shortlink expirations. putting a quick list in the PR. pinging owners.
link-scan-bot: automated scan results: 12 broken links found in /runtime/guide/* (scan id: 2026-03-20_02). Report: https://internal.reports/scan/5412345678
alex: can you paste the top 3 paths? i can take runtime/guide/ops if it's small.
mira: sure — top ones: /runtime/guide/streaming-setup, /runtime/guide/cache-tuning, /runtime/guide/kvs-cache.md
ryan: i saw the streaming-setup 403 yesterday in staging — it's the external gist rehosted. i'll rehost to our CDN and send a PR.
mira: awesome, thanks @ryan. for cache-tuning there's an old anchor mismatch — need frontmatter redirect.
sam: FYI, i can do a small sed fix for anchor links across the guide. snippet:
```
rg "#cache-tuning" -n runtime/ | sed -E "s/(old-anchor)/(new-anchor)/g"
```
lina: i can review the PRs this afternoon. pls add a brief changelog line.
ryan: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2042 — rehosted gist + updated link -> note: test preview passes locally.
mira: nice. @alex do you still want the ops page? if not i'll volunteer.
alex: i can take ops. ETA end of day. will add redirect for the shortlink too.
mira: sweet. small ask: if anyone touches runtime/guide, add `<!-- kb-scan:fixed=5412345678 -->` at top so scan ignores next run.
link-scan-bot: scan acknowledged. add tag to suppress auto reopen for 7 days.
lina: will do review when PRs are up. can we also add a TODO to backlog for long-term rehosting policy?
sam: created ticket INF-487 on backlog: 'doc asset rehosting policy' and linked PR.
mira: closing loop — thanks all. feel free to ping me if previews look odd. :thumbsup:
alex: noted. thanks!
